description: Get the economic release calendar — scheduled (upcoming) and recent publication dates of US macro data releases, with the FRED series each release updates and an importance tier per release (High = the tier-1 scheduled market movers: CPI, PPI, Employment Situation, GDP, PCE, retail sales; Medium = other genuine scheduled prints; Low = daily rate/market levels like SOFR or VIX). FOMC meetings are NOT included — FRED's release feed has no real FOMC meeting dates; use the Federal Reserve's published meeting calendar for those. Defaults to the next 30 days. Use minImportance=high to see only the market movers, and GetEconomicIndicator to fetch a series' data after it prints.

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 30 days after the start date)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of release dates to return (default: 100, max: 500, chronological)

minImportance.description: Minimum importance tier to include: low, medium, or high (defaults to low = everything)

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today, UTC)

name: GetEconomicCalendar
title: Economic Release Calendar
